entities.summary: Sean Randall Parnell is an American attorney and politician who was the tenth governor of Alaska from 2009 to 2014. He succeeded Sarah Palin in July 2009 and was elected to a full term as governor in 2010. In 2014, he narrowly lost his bid for re-election and returned to work in the private sector. He is a member of the Republican Party. Sean Parnell was a legal figures from Hanford (b. 1962-11-19, Hanford). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
